column1: NB. Estimated participant numbers have not been rounded but users must remember that they are estimates and are subject to margins of error. Refer to sheet number 34 for margin of error and relative margin of error statistics.
^ The proportion of adult participants who paid money to an organisation/venue to participate
* Estimate has relative margin of error between 50% and 100% and should be used with caution
** Estimate has relative margin of error greater than 100% and is considered too unreliable to use
